` [Highlight start] Alcohol makes your face look bloated or puffy mainly by widening blood vessels, disrupting fluid-regulating hormones, and triggering mild inflammation [Highlight end] ` . Because the skin around the eyes, cheeks, and jaw is thin or has loose connective tissue, fluid and redness often show up there first.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXfay0pU8vB3Oh5GGBV1F3ENJDh8-7QhUKh85d560wC0tH82F1Hg3YQrJWmSku7rXnGAxH77KhwWCLK8z28b1e1c-46vjPBcL__1E2pWlcKe7k-f6036d-3k9v9iCiAsZUrzyEx3OQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXzgccSDsQqS67K9-DehnHfSfrrza0c12YV1MN6IhigR3KdEsTjPs80p_ShT5EPFpC2ilKKimOeA-PgM6lkqOKLKMgrezKsHVLtU2UUJNKiK5vFnMiqWH2FZLX_yrgYE3ngM0b3rUv12lZDlSsu7O2oimIa8PU)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXXJY0BBB8fNTbb2k9BuB5CA-UHT5QsKnbjihBUyc5Y6JD3XXEehsGt2xLaGTq_UW24KWhRC1gDgmF2FyPokfjGjNtrcB_G65SloAX3yes9ToMdmKL_wberEmtdRGEvTtFi9P3edUKqWbnmiMVbB4Vzz1EELY8)

### Why It Happens

- **Fluid shifts and dehydration:** Alcohol suppresses antidiuretic hormone (vasopressin), causing you to lose fluid at first, followed by rebound water retention in surrounding tissues.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXXJY0BBB8fNTbb2k9BuB5CA-UHT5QsKnbjihBUyc5Y6JD3XXEehsGt2xLaGTq_UW24KWhRC1gDgmF2FyPokfjGjNtrcB_G65SloAX3yes9ToMdmKL_wberEmtdRGEvTtFi9P3edUKqWbnmiMVbB4Vzz1EELY8)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXfay0pU8vB3Oh5GGBV1F3ENJDh8-7QhUKh85d560wC0tH82F1Hg3YQrJWmSku7rXnGAxH77KhwWCLK8z28b1e1c-46vjPBcL__1E2pWlcKe7k-f6036d-3k9v9iCiAsZUrzyEx3OQ)
- **Widened blood vessels (vasodilation):** Blood vessels expand, leading to redness, flushing, and fluid leaking into nearby tissue.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXzgccSDsQqS67K9-DehnHfSfrrza0c12YV1MN6IhigR3KdEsTjPs80p_ShT5EPFpC2ilKKimOeA-PgM6lkqOKLKMgrezKsHVLtU2UUJNKiK5vFnMiqWH2FZLX_yrgYE3ngM0b3rUv12lZDlSsu7O2oimIa8PU)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXfay0pU8vB3Oh5GGBV1F3ENJDh8-7QhUKh85d560wC0tH82F1Hg3YQrJWmSku7rXnGAxH77KhwWCLK8z28b1e1c-46vjPBcL__1E2pWlcKe7k-f6036d-3k9v9iCiAsZUrzyEx3OQ)
- **Inflammation and extras:** Alcohol promotes low-grade inflammation, while salty late-night snacks, sugary mixers, and poor sleep can make morning puffiness worse.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXDMdTQTLsPJXrty5OrFb8LP-Xkry06slLj2zdy1d3TrU6E-6EJqQ0Sb_uyjTrS-YPBzsd2duEmlBWYYFCcEzCLk7OtlqjLYZB9s3ZCKLnGN4wudKlnEHHNEXQPs9MBAX9BqaoN9_yEVM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXzgccSDsQqS67K9-DehnHfSfrrza0c12YV1MN6IhigR3KdEsTjPs80p_ShT5EPFpC2ilKKimOeA-PgM6lkqOKLKMgrezKsHVLtU2UUJNKiK5vFnMiqWH2FZLX_yrgYE3ngM0b3rUv12lZDlSsu7O2oimIa8PU)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXX3uVRG7sRM1zc5ABmoQpUMXGBnqiTfPnzN2SlkuYxjxpJ3P5uZzgP6WGtSI1v4WfOkitFtRuzSChlUjmrzn8T0X7pDOJMXfi3e6E3qITtXGvHiG_Zjw8FP2t9F6k3pjBpOsXBq9uW2uVGl2yI0I8Kje_OjQ)
- **Longer-term changes:** Frequent or heavy drinking can contribute to lasting facial fullness, broken capillaries, weight gain, or liver-related fluid issues. Most users in a [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF1_OXrTX9JPRL1Fptq9mZx5jNbR1jD9Mh8Iz6e_1PuxCORe28sEMuEJMWpNmWR5M5y4AdNS8a3bM4jxRi80BklO5WcrJymXS2VKWwbxOEAkJrk2lFxQocHSwQOXR4O8AoEjkIVUPZor9afRtx0DZaZnqWOtI5TrRTSy-Ovj9UltyqPTzXqzpDt9Ux_a-vHO3dpmSCrCaUSKeHUmm4) thread on r/stopdrinking agree that quitting alcohol noticeably reduces facial puffiness along with overall bloat and under-eye darkness.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXDMdTQTLsPJXrty5OrFb8LP-Xkry06slLj2zdy1d3TrU6E-6EJqQ0Sb_uyjTrS-YPBzsd2duEmlBWYYFCcEzCLk7OtlqjLYZB9s3ZCKLnGN4wudKlnEHHNEXQPs9MBAX9BqaoN9_yEVM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXfay0pU8vB3Oh5GGBV1F3ENJDh8-7QhUKh85d560wC0tH82F1Hg3YQrJWmSku7rXnGAxH77KhwWCLK8z28b1e1c-46vjPBcL__1E2pWlcKe7k-f6036d-3k9v9iCiAsZUrzyEx3OQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXXJY0BBB8fNTbb2k9BuB5CA-UHT5QsKnbjihBUyc5Y6JD3XXEehsGt2xLaGTq_UW24KWhRC1gDgmF2FyPokfjGjNtrcB_G65SloAX3yes9ToMdmKL_wberEmtdRGEvTtFi9P3edUKqWbnmiMVbB4Vzz1EELY8)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF1_OXrTX9JPRL1Fptq9mZx5jNbR1jD9Mh8Iz6e_1PuxCORe28sEMuEJMWpNmWR5M5y4AdNS8a3bM4jxRi80BklO5WcrJymXS2VKWwbxOEAkJrk2lFxQocHSwQOXR4O8AoEjkIVUPZor9afRtx0DZaZnqWOtI5TrRTSy-Ovj9UltyqPTzXqzpDt9Ux_a-vHO3dpmSCrCaUSKeHUmm4)

### How to Reduce Puffiness

- **Rehydrate:** Drink water throughout the day—and alternate drinks with water when drinking—to help balance fluids.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXX3uVRG7sRM1zc5ABmoQpUMXGBnqiTfPnzN2SlkuYxjxpJ3P5uZzgP6WGtSI1v4WfOkitFtRuzSChlUjmrzn8T0X7pDOJMXfi3e6E3qITtXGvHiG_Zjw8FP2t9F6k3pjBpOsXBq9uW2uVGl2yI0I8Kje_OjQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXDMdTQTLsPJXrty5OrFb8LP-Xkry06slLj2zdy1d3TrU6E-6EJqQ0Sb_uyjTrS-YPBzsd2duEmlBWYYFCcEzCLk7OtlqjLYZB9s3ZCKLnGN4wudKlnEHHNEXQPs9MBAX9BqaoN9_yEVM)
- **Cool and drain:** Apply a cold compress or chilled roller and do gentle outward facial or neck massage to calm blood vessels and encourage fluid drainage.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXHov9eVwT0bZ9BeJtEzrsQ307VqNhJw38zhf4ZKy3r2MSAy9xaHT1ntfH8V3h5KlCgqw2bXkk-haKHlh1atNypo39OoDPtxoRDUwf9Ffej5rk5Sf7kGTJBsKrb78hUVYBvHGMVnKPcw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXX3uVRG7sRM1zc5ABmoQpUMXGBnqiTfPnzN2SlkuYxjxpJ3P5uZzgP6WGtSI1v4WfOkitFtRuzSChlUjmrzn8T0X7pDOJMXfi3e6E3qITtXGvHiG_Zjw8FP2t9F6k3pjBpOsXBq9uW2uVGl2yI0I8Kje_OjQ)
- **Adjust sleep and diet:** Sleep with your head slightly elevated, limit salty foods, and eat hydrating, potassium-rich whole foods like fruits and vegetables.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF10C0bfHUM8xVkAMIH_3Wt8De-2zrF_GWoDG0nY-gPv5EENNDoG5eeQmDbzPG06B8i4GqtifBI_TIaIUHLg7Ui9vsWCKYlC_hRYsH25AsO-N8SkBIcjAzm2-EKjl8BCvdcG_6Vh4-qK3gAE8d0cQ3_CGSD739MWTLyE2_SJOyyCT2VB9nOgvqB0rDQgOGcKe5VMt5CYM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXX3uVRG7sRM1zc5ABmoQpUMXGBnqiTfPnzN2SlkuYxjxpJ3P5uZzgP6WGtSI1v4WfOkitFtRuzSChlUjmrzn8T0X7pDOJMXfi3e6E3qITtXGvHiG_Zjw8FP2t9F6k3pjBpOsXBq9uW2uVGl2yI0I8Kje_OjQ)
- **Take a break from alcohol:** Mild next-day puffiness often improves within **24 to 72 hours** , while habitual swelling may take **one to several weeks** of cutting back or stopping.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF1615IdSLyZDmnXfW4A31HElcJ4h6QnIwLBXAZ_ACAbp_tl8SMDOPS4Yn_w2vKchjjPdRkr87YTxWhn-PuZybPimCzTpY9Y6UvhiPNda0ZaqDcWuOu7EZySnwKUPP1h8p2V-jYBL8zggRSNW0HueYwklJQ-O7s5HvgG_LDMk8_ARtI6XLg12q)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXzgccSDsQqS67K9-DehnHfSfrrza0c12YV1MN6IhigR3KdEsTjPs80p_ShT5EPFpC2ilKKimOeA-PgM6lkqOKLKMgrezKsHVLtU2UUJNKiK5vFnMiqWH2FZLX_yrgYE3ngM0b3rUv12lZDlSsu7O2oimIa8PU)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXXJY0BBB8fNTbb2k9BuB5CA-UHT5QsKnbjihBUyc5Y6JD3XXEehsGt2xLaGTq_UW24KWhRC1gDgmF2FyPokfjGjNtrcB_G65SloAX3yes9ToMdmKL_wberEmtdRGEvTtFi9P3edUKqWbnmiMVbB4Vzz1EELY8)

You can read more about the mechanics of [facial puffiness](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXfay0pU8vB3Oh5GGBV1F3ENJDh8-7QhUKh85d560wC0tH82F1Hg3YQrJWmSku7rXnGAxH77KhwWCLK8z28b1e1c-46vjPBcL__1E2pWlcKe7k-f6036d-3k9v9iCiAsZUrzyEx3OQ), [alcohol bloating](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXDMdTQTLsPJXrty5OrFb8LP-Xkry06slLj2zdy1d3TrU6E-6EJqQ0Sb_uyjTrS-YPBzsd2duEmlBWYYFCcEzCLk7OtlqjLYZB9s3ZCKLnGN4wudKlnEHHNEXQPs9MBAX9BqaoN9_yEVM) , or [post-drinking facial swelling](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXX3uVRG7sRM1zc5ABmoQpUMXGBnqiTfPnzN2SlkuYxjxpJ3P5uZzgP6WGtSI1v4WfOkitFtRuzSChlUjmrzn8T0X7pDOJMXfi3e6E3qITtXGvHiG_Zjw8FP2t9F6k3pjBpOsXBq9uW2uVGl2yI0I8Kje_OjQ) . If swelling is severe, one-sided, or lasts more than a few days alongside symptoms like abdominal swelling or yellowing skin/eyes, check in with a healthcare professional.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXDMdTQTLsPJXrty5OrFb8LP-Xkry06slLj2zdy1d3TrU6E-6EJqQ0Sb_uyjTrS-YPBzsd2duEmlBWYYFCcEzCLk7OtlqjLYZB9s3ZCKLnGN4wudKlnEHHNEXQPs9MBAX9BqaoN9_yEVM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXfay0pU8vB3Oh5GGBV1F3ENJDh8-7QhUKh85d560wC0tH82F1Hg3YQrJWmSku7rXnGAxH77KhwWCLK8z28b1e1c-46vjPBcL__1E2pWlcKe7k-f6036d-3k9v9iCiAsZUrzyEx3OQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXX3uVRG7sRM1zc5ABmoQpUMXGBnqiTfPnzN2SlkuYxjxpJ3P5uZzgP6WGtSI1v4WfOkitFtRuzSChlUjmrzn8T0X7pDOJMXfi3e6E3qITtXGvHiG_Zjw8FP2t9F6k3pjBpOsXBq9uW2uVGl2yI0I8Kje_OjQ)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXzgccSDsQqS67K9-DehnHfSfrrza0c12YV1MN6IhigR3KdEsTjPs80p_ShT5EPFpC2ilKKimOeA-PgM6lkqOKLKMgrezKsHVLtU2UUJNKiK5vFnMiqWH2FZLX_yrgYE3ngM0b3rUv12lZDlSsu7O2oimIa8PU)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF10C0bfHUM8xVkAMIH_3Wt8De-2zrF_GWoDG0nY-gPv5EENNDoG5eeQmDbzPG06B8i4GqtifBI_TIaIUHLg7Ui9vsWCKYlC_hRYsH25AsO-N8SkBIcjAzm2-EKjl8BCvdcG_6Vh4-qK3gAE8d0cQ3_CGSD739MWTLyE2_SJOyyCT2VB9nOgvqB0rDQgOGcKe5VMt5CYM)Are you looking to **reduce puffiness after a night out** , or are you noticing **ongoing facial bloating** with regular drinking? items.title: Why It Happens
items.text: Fluid shifts and dehydration: Alcohol suppresses antidiuretic hormone (vasopressin), causing you to lose fluid at first, followed by rebound water retention in surrounding tissues. Widened blood vessels (vasodilation): Blood vessels expand, leading to redness, flushing, and fluid leaking into nearby tissue. Inflammation and extras: Alcohol promotes low-grade inflammation, while salty late-night snacks, sugary mixers, and poor sleep can make morning puffiness worse. Longer-term changes: Frequent or heavy drinking can contribute to lasting facial fullness, broken capillaries, weight gain, or liver-related fluid issues. Most users in a Reddit thread on r/stopdrinking agree that quitting alcohol noticeably reduces facial puffiness along with overall bloat and under-eye darkness.

items.title: How to Reduce Puffiness
items.text: Rehydrate: Drink water throughout the day—and alternate drinks with water when drinking—to help balance fluids. Cool and drain: Apply a cold compress or chilled roller and do gentle outward facial or neck massage to calm blood vessels and encourage fluid drainage. Adjust sleep and diet: Sleep with your head slightly elevated, limit salty foods, and eat hydrating, potassium-rich whole foods like fruits and vegetables. Take a break from alcohol: Mild next-day puffiness often improves within 24 to 72 hours, while habitual swelling may take one to several weeks of cutting back or stopping.
